name: Sodium
author: jellysquid3
summary: The fastest and most compatible rendering optimization mod for Minecraft. Now available for both NeoForge and Fabric!
descriptionHtml:
Sodium

Sodium is a powerful rendering engine for Minecraft which improves frame rates and reduces micro-stutter, while fixing many graphical issues.

  • Up to 3x faster chunk rendering
  • Reduced memory usage
  • Compatible with most Fabric mods

On a dedicated server it simply stays out of the way: the mod only loads on the client side of an integrated server.
